claims.claim_text: In this paper, we introduce CARLA (Car Learning to Act) – an open simulator for urban driving.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA is an open simulator for urban driving.
claims.source_quote: In this paper, we introduce CARLA (Car Learning to Act) – an open simulator for urban driving.

claims.claim_text: CARLA has been developed from the ground up to support training, prototyping, and validation of autonomous driving models, including both perception and control.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA supports training, prototyping, and validation of autonomous driving models including perception and control.
claims.source_quote: CARLA has been developed from the ground up to support training, prototyping, and validation of autonomous driving models, including both perception and control.

claims.claim_text: The content of urban environments provided with CARLA is also free.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA provides free urban environment content.
claims.source_quote: Uniquely, the content of urban environments provided with CARLA is also free.

claims.claim_text: The content was created from scratch by a dedicated team of digital artists employed for this purpose.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA's urban environment content was created from scratch by a dedicated team of digital artists.
claims.source_quote: The content was created from scratch by a dedicated team of digital artists employed for this purpose.

claims.claim_text: It includes urban layouts, a multitude of vehicle models, buildings, pedestrians, street signs, etc.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA includes urban layouts, vehicle models, buildings, pedestrians, and street signs.
claims.source_quote: It includes urban layouts, a multitude of vehicle models, buildings, pedestrians, street signs, etc.
